content: You cannot plow a field simply by turning it over in your mind.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: You can spend twenty years analyzing agricultural textbooks, daydreaming about lush harvests, and debating soil mechanics. But until your hands grip the wooden handles, the blade bites into the sod, and you walk behind the oxen in the cold mud, no crop will ever grow. Execute.
practicalInsight: Stop over-thinking and planning. Take actual physical action on that project for sixty uninterrupted minutes today.
reflectionPrompt: What 'field' have you been turning over endlessly in your mind without ever setting your hands to the plow?
